name: Citadel Siege 2
detailed_description:
Citadel Siege 2 is a tactical tower defense game where strategy, timing, and adaptation are the keys to survival.

Your mission is to build and adapt your defenses to stop waves of increasingly dangerous enemies from reaching your citadel.

The darkness has returned — smarter, faster, and stronger. Enemy hordes now strike in larger numbers, using new tactics to overwhelm your lines. Some enemies rush forward at high speed, some split into more dangerous forms when destroyed, and others resist or ignore your attacks entirely.

But you’re not without hope. Unlock new defenders, including fire-wielding towers that incinerate enemy groups, poison traps that slowly wear down even the toughest foes, and a diverse army of warriors — melee fighters, ranged archers, and support units that enhance your strategy.

Success requires more than just placing towers. You’ll need to block paths, funnel enemies into traps, and adjust your tactics on the fly as the battlefield shifts with each wave.

Will your steel, fire, and poison be enough to hold the line when the siege begins again?

Key Features:

  • 🔥 New defenders with devastating fire-based attacks

  • 🧱 Wider paths and more complex enemy movement

  • 👾 Smarter, tougher enemies with unique mechanics

  • 🧠 Tactical gameplay that evolves with each level

  • 🖼️ Enhanced visuals and a darker, more intense atmosphere

The fate of the citadel lies in your hands.
Only the most strategic minds will endure.
